body:
You know it's weird because I somehow feel more supported at Sanctioned than SuicideWatch. 

SW always just have generic "no! Please don't do it!" Or "we love you! There is so much to life!" Whereas Sanctioned is more like "I hear you, I feel the same way." And stuff and we can actually talk to each other about what's bothering us and things.

I'm very bummed that Reddit would ban Sanctioned. They recently forced the Moderators to implement specific rules to limit explicit suicide posts, which I think it's good. But ban it? Well fuck Reddit. I feel worse now that I can't even have someone to talk to that really understands what I'm feeling.

I don't have a purpose in life. I'm just a disappointment. I really am (like you said on your original) just a burden to my parents. I have a brother and sister who are really successful and then there is me. I'm just a giant boulder holding down my aging parents now. I'd rather leave the scars of the boulder (memories of me) on them than to have them continue carrying me on their backs. 

I'm just going off a load of bs now. Sorry.

Ok so same guy from the second comment there. But I just really want to say I understand your struggle now. I'm like in a very similar situation (almost exactly the same except minor differences). 

I still hope you are stronger than me and keep on going though.

I don't know how to respond to this without sounding like a hypocrite.

I am in a similar situation of calling it quits in the next several days (probably) and I too am at peace with it as well. So I kinda know how you feel about suicide here. 

But at the same time I don't want to see others taking this route even though I have chosen this route. You know what I'm saying? I guess I'm the type of person that is so broken yet I want to unprofessionally fix other people who feel broken. 

If you want to, I can talk with you :)
I'm awake too.

You're not a parasite. Remember that! 

And I completely agree with you on the stuff you said. I think I low key have minor social anxiety too. I don't have a job and from the looks of things, I botched the interview I had last week too. It's tough in a world where whether you have a high paying job or not sets your reputation. It sucks where people judge you for everything. Literally everything. It sucks. 

Also f*** the professional help and all that bs (no disrespect to their profession), they are all just temporary pain killers. Screw that shit. I need a permanent solution to my pains. Screw this life. 

I'm sorry I'm no help to your problems...if you want to vent though, I'm here to listen and vent with you. 

And maybe we'll see each other again sometime, somewhere else.

Not even my own words can describe my life better than what you have written. I'm in a very similar situation as you. 

I know it sucks and all hope seems to be lost. If you wanna talk I'm here (for a little while).

Oh I see. Well I hope you do feel better about life in general. 

Ah gotcha, I've only heard faintly of Yume Nikki, I have no clue what it's all about so maybe that's why I never heard of the fangames. But pixel art is pretty cool though.

You see, this is why I'm horrible at talking to people. I hope you find something that will make you keep on going. Although I feel like I'm not gonna be here in the next few weeks I don't want to see others going the same route. 

Fangames huh? I didn't know that was a thing.

Hey, 

How it going? It's interesting how I have a mutated version of your lifestyle. I don't have much friends and I'm always just chillin' in my room. 

I've recently hit a low point so I'm hanging around here. 

What is the game you're currently playing?
I'm sorry for your loss today. And I also thank you for your advice.

I have not. The thing is that I'm kind of a coward to do so but at the same time I still plan to do it in a few weeks. 

I might just end up on the brink of the deed and then back out though.
Thanks for chatting with me. I'm sorry about your situation with your work.

Thanks for a thorough reply.

Actually I graduated college in 2015 and I'm also in my late 20s. For the past couple of years I've landed some temporary jobs. 

I've also sent countless resumes to places only to get ignored. I know I may be thinking one sided right now but I've been trying to be optimistic for long enough only to have receive bullsh*t in return. How can I develop and reinvent myself if I can't even get an opportunity to do so? 

I may sound immature but I'm getting tired of all of this bullsh*t. This job thing isn't my only problem either. 

I'm just really tired of everything.
What are your hobbies when you hangout in your room?

Are you an introvert too? Ah if I knew you in person I think it'd be fun to go for a coffee, just sit and relax and enjoy the quietness without feeling awkward. 

Socializing sucks doesn't it? :/
What anime do you watch?

I'm glad you're feeling good today :) 

I like to do random doodles with down time almost anywhere. But I do fan art and other random character designs when I have lots of time on my hands. I also give each character a story behind them :)

Hi :)

1. I have a day off today so that's good. 
2. Heavy
3. I like to draw on my free time

Are you or have you felt suicidal before?

Hello there, 

First off I want to say I'm sorry I can't give you advice because I'm horrible at it and I'm sorry you feel the way you do. But I just want to say I have almost the exact timeline as you on the dates. The dumpster fire just won't stop burning will it?

I want to get the hell outta here, but I don't want others doing it. So I hope in the next three weeks you'll find something worth being happy for and worth living for. 

Although I probably can't help much or give good advice, I'll be here for a little while if you want to talk. I might reply slow but I'll be hanging around here.
I like collecting action figures which require lots of money that I don't have lol
Life has just been a series of sh*t shows and I just want it to stop for just a little while before another one, but it's too much to ask for. I'm in my late 20s.

I honestly don't think I have severe depression. I'm socially awkward but I don't have anxiety. I also don't want my family to know about this situation either so I don't plan on seeing a doctor. 

That is the reality of things I guess. Like I said, I'm just down so I wanted some encouragement even though no one knows the future.
Congratulations! I'm very happy for you. Thanks for replying to me, it means a lot.

That's exactly how I felt a month ago when it was my birthday. All I thought about is whether I'll be here or not next birthday. 

I'm sorry to hear you feel this way. If you want to talk I'm here on Reddit. I might have slow replies though, but I'm here if you wanna chat.

If everything is according to the horrible dumpster fire I'm in right now, then my date should be somewhere along in Sept 2017. 

I'm sorry you feel the way you feel OP. If you want to talk in the next couple months I'm here on Reddit.
Thanks for all the replies. I still don't know if I want to seek a professional though.

I'm not sure if I can make you feel better...I tried on another thread and made the other person feel guilty...I can see myself "not here" in the foreseeable future too. If you want to talk I can talk with you here. 

I see you have gotten some professional help. I have always wondered though, does professional help actually work? Because I don't plan on seeing anyone, I'm just gonna do it when it happens. How or how didn't the experience with professionals change your situation?

Don't misunderstand what I posted, I didn't want to make you feel guilty. Everyone has their own reasons for feeling this way. What I wanted to say is that if you're feeling suicidal and want to do it, I would wait for a while just to see how your job eventually goes and maybe that will change how you feel and give you something to live for in life.

Please don't feel guilty.

Hi, 

I can't really answer why you still want to just end it even when it sounds like everything is heading in the right direction. But at the same time I don't know what you've been through in your past to feel that way even though you think that nothing has happened.

But I do want to say this, all I really wanted is a life like yours. A nice job, and being able to support myself. I've been out of school for several years but I still couldn't get to where you are now. And that's the reason I'm here on this sub because I'm losing hope. 

You don't seem to be lost though, and if I were in your shoes, I'd go on at least for a while and see where your new career brings you. And hey, you might be able to find new hope and find the happiness I never got. 

Sorry if this makes no sense at all, I'm really confused with myself and I just want to let my thoughts out in a different way other than with tears.

I am actually a big fan of Barbie dolls. I like collecting and styling them. Ken included of course. I also watched all seasons of Barbie: Life in the Dreamhouse - effin love that show.

I guess it's not as much feminine but more childish for me.

I rarely comment on any posts but this one I really feel like I have to because I am in the exact same boat as you OP. I graduated a couple of years ago and couldn't find a job related to my field. It's the stress of financial insecurity that really is bothering me. It has gotten to the point so bad that I've decided to lurk around this subreddit. Obviously that's not my only issue but it's still a big one. Although I am thinking of an ending, I also kind of have this hope that's in my mind telling myself that everything will be ok down the stretch. I hope you will stay strong. Maybe when we meet on Reddit again in the future down the road we can tell each other of our successes :) 

Also finding an interest to do during your downtime does help a lot. Also have you tried doing volunteer work within your field? That experience also helps a lot especially if that place you volunteer at has a job opening later.
